name: KodRxFHIRImplementationGuide
title: KodRx FHIR R4 Implementation Guide

text.div:
KodRx FHIR R4 Implementation Guide

Defines the FHIR R4 interoperability artifacts used by KodRx for verified digital prescriptions.

description: Implementation Guide defining the FHIR R4 interoperability artifacts used by KodRx for verified digital prescriptions, including prescription identifiers, provenance extensions and the KodRx reference Bundle.

resource.name: KodRx Blockchain Hash Extension
resource.description: Extension containing the cryptographic hash associated with a verified KodRx prescription.

resource.name: KodRx Blockchain Block Extension
resource.description: Extension containing the blockchain block number associated with a verified KodRx prescription.

resource.name: KodRx Prescription ID Extension
resource.description: Extension containing the originating KodRx prescription identifier.

resource.name: KodRx Prescription Identifier NamingSystem
resource.description: NamingSystem defining the identifier namespace used for KodRx prescriptions.

resource.name: KodRx Reference Bundle v1
resource.description: Reference example demonstrating a verified KodRx prescription represented as a FHIR R4 Bundle.
